answer: Reputation Lockbox: 1) Deposit $5 collateral per identity. 2) Reputation increases with positive interactions, decreases with negative. 3) Trigger a challenge if suspicious activity is observed. 4) If reputation drops below 50% ($2.50), collateral is slashed. For N identities, cost is $5N. Failure occurs if a coordinated group falsely accuses participants. This system operates like a locked juniper box, protecting valuable assets from the harsh mesa winds of deceit, ensuring trust flows like a clear ocean.
